required_input_elements_visible: TCGA / GTEx / in-house image FM data cylinders
reviews.rationale: The crop does show the actual histology input source for H2O pretraining, but it is larger than needed and includes downstream/alignment material that does not add input evidence. A tighter left-column crop around the H&E patch and dataset cylinders is the smallest coherent region that still grounds the route.
The crop visibly and readably shows the paired H&E and spatial-sequencing inputs and the immediate fusion/prediction path, which is sufficient evidence for the benchmark fine-tuning route.
This crop still clearly exposes the input route and fusion interface for the PRAD fine-tuning architecture. It is a grounded model-input figure, not an output-only or benchmark-only panel.

The crop cleanly captures the multimodal architecture panel with the single-cell gene-expression input path and reconstruction interface. That is enough to ground the single-cell Q-Former and reconstruction routes.

The figure directly shows the model-visible carriers and fusion point for all three conditioning routes: cell type, gene profile, and promoter sequence. It is the correct minimal architecture evidence for this model.
